regions.translation: Another [remedy]: jbw-plant 1/8, celery 1/32, peas 1/64, sweet beer 10 ro; boil; expose to the dew overnight; strain; to be drunk over four days.

regions.translation: Another: barley-water whose substance is removed, pounded and toasted barley 5 ro, costus (?) 2 ro, ḏrt 1 ro, honey 2 ro, mwt of rkrk 1 ro, sycamore 1 ro, are boiled, strained, it remains during the night in the dew and is drunk for 4 days.

regions.translation: Another to repel hrematuria: nḥbwt of balk, is boiled with oil and given against it.

regions.translation: The beginning of remedies made by Rê on his own behalf: lukewarm honey 1, wax 1, chip of frankincense 1, fruit of śjt 1, ḏrt 1, šš 1, mwt of rush-nut 1, fruit of ḏjś 1, bw 1, ḫśjt 1, ḫntt of frankincense 1, minium (?) 1, fruit of coriander 1, chip of juniperus 1, chip of pine 1, fresh porridge, are mixed together, and the sick places are bandaged therewith. It expels afflictions (caused) by a god, (by) dead man or woman and all kinds of purulency in all limbs of a man, so that he may become well immediately.

regions.translation: Another, a second remedy made by Shu on his own behalf: powder of wheat 1, northern salt 1, oil 1, powder of coriander 1, soot from the wall 1, powder of ḏrt 1, powder of bean 1, frankincense 1, costus (?) 1, yellow ochre 1, viscous fluid 1, are mixed together, and the sick places are bandaged therewith.

regions.translation: Another, a third remedy made by Tefnut for Rê himself: powder of ʿmʿʿ 1, silphium (?) 1, goose-fat 1, are enclosed in any thing, and all sick places and all, afflictions (caused) by a god or goddess are bandaged, so that he may become well immediately.

regions.translation: A fourth remedy made by Geb for Rê himself: powder of ḏrt 1, powder of tḥw 1, powder of myrtle (?) 1, are ground fine with lees of date-wine,
